title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize build cache
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: our monolithic CI workflows have become slow and fragile (long runs, cache misses, flaky release jobs). This PR splits lint/test/release into discrete workflows, standardizes cache keys across repos, and performs a small set of dependency hygiene updates for GH Actions and Node toolchains. Goals: 1) reduce average CI runtime by parallelizing independent jobs; 2) improve cache hit rate across matrix runs; 3) make release automation more reliable with clear gating and retries; 4) uplift actions and node versions for security/speed. Changes are intentionally additive and covered by CI. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows: lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml, build-cache.yml - [x] Consolidate cache key logic and move common steps to reusable actions - [x] Bump actions/setup-node to v4 and actions/cache hygiene - [x] Add targeted dependency updates to action versions and workflow templates - [x] Add retry and timeout policies to flaky integration tests - [x] Update docs: CONTRIBUTING.md CI section Notes: This PR touches workflow hygiene only; no application code changes. Release workflow now requires successful test.yml and lint.yml and adds a manual approval gate for production releases. See commits for details and the CI checks summary for the validation matrix.
